summaryPoints.text: Compliance said "customer data" in the export must include derived and analytics data, not just profile fields.
Product said it has been scoping "customer data" as profile data only so the export stays small.

actionItems.text: Product and Compliance need to agree on a single definition of "customer data" for the export, since the Eng estimate depends on which one wins.
Once the definition is settled, Eng should confirm the export scope and whether it can ship this sprint.

confusions.text: Compliance uses "customer data" to include derived and analytics data, while Product uses it to mean profile data only.
